title: AgentAction
description: One tool call by an agent session, with identifiers extracted by adapter signatures. Local only; synced only as redacted evidence inside an Attribution.

id.description: The Claude Code tool_use_id of the action.

session_id.description: The Claude Code session id (a UUID).

agent_id.description: Subagent id when the call ran inside a subagent.

input_excerpt.description: Redacted text excerpt. Never contains secrets: redacted at record time and again at output.

result_excerpt.description: Redacted text excerpt. Never contains secrets: redacted at record time and again at output.

provider_guess.description: Provider slug from the adapter file, e.g. supabase or vercel. Not an enum: new adapters add providers without schema changes.

Identifier.description: A resource identifier found in this action by an adapter signature.

provider.description: Provider slug from the adapter file, e.g. supabase or vercel. Not an enum: new adapters add providers without schema changes.

kind.description: Resource kind as <provider>.<kind>, e.g. supabase.table or vercel.deployment.

value.description: The provider id or natural key (e.g. a project ref, dpl_ id, or schema.table).

container.description: The container the value is unique within, e.g. a project ref for a table or bucket, or team/project for a Vercel env var.

role.description: created: the signature matches a creating call. referenced: the id merely appeared (e.g. a list or read call). Only 'created' can produce an exact label.

excerpt.description: Redacted text excerpt. Never contains secrets: redacted at record time and again at output.
